dedupe_keys.name: cugmine fine grained land cover dataset of 226 open pit mines in yunnan china 2016 and 2022

description: CUGMine is a land cover dataset for open-pit mining areas, with high-resolution satellite images and pixel-level land cover labels for 226 mines in Yunnan Province, China, for training and testing segmentation models. The figshare record says images come from Google Earth at about 1.1 to 1.2 m, in 512 by 512 pixel GeoTIFF tiles (plus 966 tiles of 256 by 256 in the training set), for 2016 and 2022, with 2,656 image-label pairs split into training (2,010), validation (322) and test (324); labels have six classes: grassland, forest, buildings, road, bare land and water. The record is at version 9, modified on 16 September 2026, with one zip of about 1.24 GB and a README, free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: imagery is from Google Earth, whose own terms may apply, there is no explicit 'mine pit' class, and coverage is one province. For simulation it gives labelled data to track land cover change and restoration around open-pit mines over time, for environmental impact and recovery studies. Related catalogue records include the Mine remote sensing datasets for Hubei and Jiangxi and the global ML-ready mining area dataset.
